answer: New identities may enter the economy only through a single metered inlet: a bonded proof-of-work ticket unique to a hardware fingerprint. Payouts stay in escrow until the agent's attested surplus delta remains positive across several independent validators and epochs. When attestors see tightly correlated submissions, they circulate a short whisper of the shared fingerprint, after which those tickets are burned and no further countersignatures are granted. Mass-created sybils therefore spend the bond and never unlock rewards.
